_comment: The badges (docs/draft/badges.md): achievements the Dungeon Master awards, judged at each kept save (game/badges). A rule sets exactly one of quest, any_quest, collection (fish, gems, ores: any of the player's characters; songs, towns, wilds, places: one character), level, or counter + at. rank groups a series shown by its highest earned. Art: badge-media.json.

badges.name: Heir to the Vault
badges.description: Claimed your inheritance from the vault your caretaker's letter sent you to.

badges.name: The Rising Shadow
badges.description: Fetched what Oracle Seraphina's ritual needed, and saw the dark cloud over the mountains.

badges.name: The Black Flame
badges.description: Put out the black flame in the old watchtower on the Merchant's Highway.

badges.name: The Shadow's Source
badges.description: Found the source of the corruption in the Sunken Temple.

badges.name: Barbarian Fishing
badges.description: Caught a leaping salmon with your bare hands for Ottar Bare-Hand.

badges.name: The Rats of Goldenhaven
badges.description: Cleared the tavern cellar of its oversized rats.

badges.name: The Missing Heirloom
badges.description: Got the Mayor's signet ring back from the highway bandits.

badges.name: The Missing Mule
badges.description: Brought Buttercup the mule back from the mountain pass.

badges.name: The One That Got Away
badges.description: Landed big ones for Finn Brackwater, in more than one kind of water.

badges.name: The Golden Toll
badges.description: Brought the Scalekeeper's crate in with its seal unbroken.

badges.name: A Stone Worth Carving
badges.description: Fetched heartstone from a kobold-held seam for Thorin Ironledger.

badges.name: The Crown's Ledger
badges.description: Found the missing page of the Royal Ledger of Bonds.

badges.name: Prove Your Mettle
badges.description: Killed the merrow taking Marshlight's fishers, and burned their nest.

badges.name: Keys Go Missing
badges.description: Found Rosie Lockwood's three lost keys.

badges.name: Root and Song
badges.description: Were heard by the heartwood sapling of Verdant.

badges.name: The Dormant Spire
badges.description: Woke the Kingdom's waystone.

badges.name: The Windmill Stone
badges.description: Found Millhaven's lost crown-stone and woke its waystone.

badges.name: The Elders' Song
badges.description: Freed Verdant's waystone from what was strangling it.

badges.name: The Harbor Beacon
badges.description: Brought Goldenhaven's lodestone beacon home.

badges.name: The Source of the Fade
badges.description: Struck at the Fade where it rises from Marshlight's black water.

badges.name: Beneath the Flooded Mine
badges.description: Woke the Deepstone, and the whole waystone network with it.

badges.name: The Paladin's Vow
badges.description: Laid the restless spirits of the Forgotten Battlefield to rest.

badges.name: The Rogue's Shadow Trial
badges.description: Passed the Master of Shadows' trial.

badges.name: Elven Heritage
badges.description: Restored the light of the forest's waystones.

badges.name: The Axe of the Ancestors
badges.description: Recovered your clan's lost axe from the depths of the Flooded Mine.

badges.name: Angler of the Realm
badges.description: Caught one of every fish.

badges.name: The Jeweller's Eye
badges.description: Found one of every gem, pearls too.

badges.name: Deep Delver
badges.description: Mined every ore, iron to adamantine.

badges.name: Every Song Heard
badges.description: Heard every song in the realm.

badges.name: Freedom of the Realm
badges.description: Visited every town.

badges.name: Wayfarer
badges.description: Crossed every wild region.

badges.name: Cartographer
badges.description: Found every place there is: every town, every wild and every place of note.

badges.name: A Reliable Hand
badges.description: Did 10 dailies for the vault keepers.

badges.name: Trusted by the Vaults
badges.description: Did 50 dailies for the vault keepers.

badges.name: Pillar of the Realm
